description:
The nightmare consumes you! Sucked deep into the dark of Azeroths most dangerous reaches, you'll need to complete all dungeons in order to escape. With only one life, 300% more damage from physical attacks, and 500% more damage from spells, you'll need every ally you can find to overcome this terrifying trial. Will you emerge victorious, or be consumed by the terrors of the night?
